rows.note: Use this for something that happened or began only a short time ago, especially the immediate-past sense.

example.english: They newly opened the shop, and customers are already waiting outside.
example.traditional: 啱啱開門，已經有客喺門口等喇。
example.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 hoi1 mun4 ji5 ging1 jau5 haak3 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 laa3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for recently or lately when the time span is not restricted to just now.

example.english: The bus company has newly introduced an overnight route recently, making it much easier to go out at night.
example.traditional: 最近巴士公司開咗條通宵線，夜晚出街方便咗好多。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 baa1 si2 gung1 si1 hoi1 zo2 tiu4 tung1 siu1 sin3 je6 maan5 ceot1 gaai1 fong1 bin6 zo2 hou2 do1
